overall_assessment: UiT extraction via #maincontents is generally faithful: whole plans, correct year per p_document_id, no site chrome, and the uncaptured text is only year pickers and staff boxes. The short-flagged suspects are genuinely thin source pages (2008-2012 master-thesis stubs), not extraction losses. Remaining defects are cosmetic: leaked HTML markup/entities, old-layout pages with glued or split lines, and a duplicated title header.

findings.description: Raw HTML markup (escaped div tags) and an unescaped HTML entity (på) appear in the extracted text, from source fields that contain HTML as literal text. Not plan content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The source system stores some fields with HTML as escaped text; html_text() returns it verbatim, and no post_fn decodes entities or strips tags.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a uit post_fn in R/institution_config.R that strips literal <...> tags (e.g. gsub('<[^>]+>', ' ', x)) and decodes HTML entities (å, ø, æ,  ) before whitespace cleanup.

findings.evidence: FRA-3903 Mastergradsoppgave i fransk - integrert 10 sp PPU - 40 stp
findings.description: On old-layout pages (2008-2012) the course code, title and credits are repeated as a header line after the facts box; in some pages the header is split into one token per line ('FRA-3903', ' ', title, ' ', '-', '40', 'stp'). It duplicates the first lines (Emnekode, title, Studiepoeng) and adds noise.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The old page template has a title heading inside #maincontents with inline spans; blocks.R emits each span as its own line.
findings.suggested_fix: In the uit post_fn, drop the header line matching '^<code> .* - \d+ stp$' and the split variant (consecutive lines code / blank / title / blank / '-' / number / 'stp'), since the facts box already carries them.

findings.evidence: Etter bestått emne skal studentene ha følgende læringsresultat: Kunnskaper og forståelse: Kjennskap til hovedlinjer i pedagogisk lærings- og undervisningsteori Kunnskap om generelle utfordringer
findings.description: On some old-layout pages, the learning outcomes, exam form and work requirements are one long paragraph with list items run together (also a stray split word 'h ele'). Structure is lost, which makes later section cutting harder.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The source page has the lists inside one block without list/br markup, or the br tags are not turned into line breaks.
findings.suggested_fix:

Obligatoriske arbeidskrav

Følgende arbeidskrav må være gjennomført og godkjent før man kan framstille seg til eksamen
findings.description: New-layout pages carry the exam and work requirement table ('Eksamener' / 'Obligatoriske arbeidskrav') and then 'Mer info om arbeidskrav', which restates the same requirements. This is two page blocks, not an extraction error; it is only mild redundancy, and the reading-list heading 'Pensumliste for ... HØST 2025' appears without the list itself (the list is behind a Leganto link).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page itself has both a structured table and a free-text description.
findings.suggested_fix: No change needed. Optionally note in data notes that UiT pensum lists on new pages are external (Leganto) and not in the text.
